bugs.name: Deleting a warehouse reports “Warehouse updated” in the success toast
bugs.summary: After confirming deletion of a newly created disposable warehouse, the warehouse disappeared from the list, but the success toast said “Warehouse updated.”
bugs.expected: After confirming deletion and returning to the warehouse list, the success notification should accurately indicate that the warehouse was deleted.
bugs.actual: The fresh warehouse was removed from the list, but the success notification read “Warehouse updated.”
reproSteps: Sign in as the fixture Saleor admin and open Configuration > Warehouses.
Create a disposable warehouse with a valid address, then open its detail page.
Click Delete and confirm deletion. Observe that the warehouse disappears from the list while the success toast says “Warehouse updated.”

bugs.name: Warehouse creation drops a valid email address
bugs.summary: Creating a warehouse with a valid email succeeds, but the new warehouse detail page has a blank Email field; editing the email after creation saves it.
bugs.expected: The email entered on Create Warehouse should be retained on the saved warehouse.
bugs.actual: A new warehouse created with `eng5423-warehouse@example.test` had an empty Email field on its detail page, while its name and address were retained. Entering the same email on the detail page and saving persisted it after reload.
reproSteps: Sign in to the local Saleor dashboard and open Configuration > Warehouses > Create Warehouse.
Enter a unique warehouse name, a valid email, and the required address fields, then select Save.
Inspect the new warehouse detail page: the Email field is blank.
Enter the same email on the detail page, save, and reload; the email now persists.

bugs.name: Country area selection is cleared when saving a warehouse
bugs.summary: Selecting California visibly in Country area is reproducibly cleared on Save, which rejects the warehouse as missing that required field; the unsaved drafts were discarded and the eight existing warehouses left untouched.
bugs.expected: After selecting California in the Country area field and saving a completed warehouse form, the selection should remain and the warehouse should be accepted.
bugs.actual: On two fresh create-form attempts, California was visible in Country area before Save. Save cleared the field, marked it red with “This field is required,” and left the form unsaved. The validation remained after the page settled for five seconds; the first attempt also showed an error toast with that message.
reproSteps: Using the configured saved admin session (admin role), open /configuration/.
Search settings for “warehouse,” open the Warehouses result under Shipping & delivery, then select Create Warehouse. The create form is at /warehouses/add.
Create a fresh draft named cfgwarehouse-verify-20260412-002. Enter a valid test email (cfgwarehouse-verify-20260412-002@example.com) and ordinary company/address/city/postal/phone values.
In Country, search for United States and select the “United States of America” option.
Open Country area, search for California, and select the California option. Verify that California is visibly displayed in the field.
Select Save. Observe that Country area becomes blank and red, “This field is required” appears beneath it, and the form remains unsaved. Wait five seconds and verify the error persists.
For cleanup, select Back and confirm Ignore changes. Verify the warehouse list still contains the eight pre-existing records; no draft was saved.
